status: FROZEN before any game (sha256 journalled in balance/v4/journal.ndjson as 'dev-preregistered', together with the implementation hashes). Authorised by the operator's V4.1 review (2026-11-20 08:02 UTC): one bounded 300-game offline development experiment, run once.
scope: PLANNER-SPECIFIC development evidence about one self-play planner family (the EV candidate and three single-factor variants). It says nothing about human players or other AI strategies, and nothing is promoted. The holdout seeds 65001-65060 are not used.
question: Are the balance problems the V4 pilot showed under the honest (EV) planner (second-mover advantage, Human/AI-side gap, opening collapse) caused mainly by the game rules, or by this planner's behaviour and limitations?

seeds.note: fresh development seeds; never used or reserved before (V4 pilot 64001-64030, holdout 65001-65060, smoke 99001-99499)

arms.label: control: EV candidate ev-teleport-v4.1, defaults, vs itself
hold-back candidates, executed as chosen, both sides
K1 vs E0 head-to-head, K1 on each side and each first-mover order per seed

rules: Run exactly once; the runner refuses a second 'dev-start' and refuses if the protocol or any frozen implementation hash differs.
Production rules (3 v 3, no start configuration, no rule variant, no planner hooks). Only the EV variant flags differ between arms.
0 external calls (V3 offline worker guard), 0 Kane calls.
No rerun of failed or unflattering games. A factor whose manipulation check fails is reported NOT_INFORMATIVE, not re-tuned.

registeredHypotheses.claim: The Human/AI-side gap comes from board-coordinate tie-breaking.
registeredHypotheses.headToHead: H1 reported descriptively: K1's decisive win rate as Human and as AI, with Wilson intervals

registeredHypotheses.claim: The second-mover advantage comes from the reply model ignoring opponent placements.
registeredHypotheses.caveat: Existing probes: K2 improves prediction (mean abs error, see manipulation.json) but did not change the chosen opening. Better prediction is not assumed to produce better actions.

registeredHypotheses.claim: The second-mover advantage and the opening collapse come from the planner never comparing holding back.
registeredHypotheses.reported: distinct openings, hold-back turns per game

metrics.first_mover_win_rate: decisive games won by the first mover
metrics.human_side_win_rate / abs_human_side_edg: decisive games won by the Human side; distance from 0.5
metrics.turn2_captures_per_game: pieces captured on turn 2 (the second mover's first turn)
metrics.distinct_openings: distinct first-three-placement signatures over both sides; distinct turn-1 placements
metrics.foresight: teleport advantage over blind expectation (V3 method), information fairness must stay at ~0
metrics.safety and replay: illegal moves, errors, softlocks; every game re-executed by the engine

uncertainty: Kx - E0 paired by seed, seeded bootstrap 5000 resamples (seed 66000); rates with Wilson 95%; foresight bootstrap 95%

decisionRules.prediction: V3 judge rule: 'met' if the difference is in the predicted direction by at least minEffect and its 95% interval excludes 0; 'contradicted' if the interval excludes an effect of minEffect in the predicted direction; else 'unclear'. Hypothesis: SUPPORTED if all predictions met, REFUTED if any contradicted, else INCONCLUSIVE.
decisionRules.manipulation: K1: mirror mismatches 0 in the pre-run check; K2: chosen plan differs from E0 on some pre-run positions or the in-game behaviour differs; K3: at least one hold-back turn per 10 games. Failing = NOT_INFORMATIVE for that factor.
decisionRules.guards: for each Kx vs E0: V4 pilot gates G1 length, G2 turn limit, G4 diversity, G5 comebacks, G6 safety/replay, and information fairness (foresight interval contains 0 and |mean| < 0.3). Reported, they do not change hypothesis outcomes.
decisionRules.crucialQuestion: PLANNER-DRIVEN (this planner family) if at least one factor's first-mover difference vs E0 has a 95% interval lower bound > 0 AND that arm's first-mover Wilson interval contains 0.5; NOT EXPLAINED BY THESE PLANNER FACTORS if E0's first-mover interval excludes 0.5 and every factor's first-mover difference has an upper bound < 0.10 (leans toward the rules, or toward planner limits not tested here; not proof); INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. The same structure is applied to the Human/AI-side gap with K1 and abs_human_side_edge.
